newsitem.title: GREECE: Drachma up vs mark, ecu, down vs $, yen in June.
newsitem.headline: Drachma up vs mark, ecu, down vs $, yen in June.

text.p: The drachma rose 0.61 percent month-on-month against the mark, 0.37 percent against the ecu in June, and 0.71 percent versus the French franc but fell 0.81 percent versus the $ and 4.6 percent against the yen, Ionian Research said.
The drachma was stable vis-a-vis the Italian lira in June but slipped 1.4 percent against the pound sterling, Ionian said in its monthly report.
Average fixing rates were used in the calculations, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
